name: CalaverasGROWN Certified Farmers' Market San Andreas
tagline: UC Master Gardeners of Calaveras County
description: CalaverasGROWN Certified Farmers' Market San Andreas is a farmers market in 891 Mountain Ranch Road, CA, bringing together local growers, bakers, and makers. Shoppers can find seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from area farms. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
